trigger_condition: The new addopts `--ignore-glob=agents/*/test_client.py --suppress-no-test-exit-code`, plus the new `pytest-custom-exit-code` dev dependency, make `uv run pytest` from the repo root always exit 0 with zero tests collected, so it never executes the only checks that exercise the new agents' behavior.
guard_snippet: No `def test_*` function anywhere asserts GuideResponse's 3-8 step-range validator (howto-guide-agent/agent.py:650-658), HowToGuideExecutor's `result.status == 'error'` branch (howto-guide-agent/__main__.py:530-534), or TextInsightsAgent's status-relayed summary/error path (text-insights-agent/agent.py:1312-1332) as part of the repo's automated `pytest` entry point.
potential_consequence: A regression in either new agent's error handling (e.g. HowToGuideExecutor no longer branching on result.status, or the steps/key_points range validators being dropped or loosened) ships without the automated check failing: `uv run pytest` reports success either way, since it collects nothing from these agents by design. The only checks that would observe the regression are the per-agent test_client.py scripts, which require a live server on localhost plus real LLM credentials and must be run manually per the README's 'Check: uv run test_client.py' step.
consumer: the repository's own `uv run pytest` entry point at python/pyproject.toml, documented as the project's test command, and any CI that would eventually be wired to it
evidence: Read python/pyproject.toml:26-46 — the new [tool.pytest.ini_options] section adds addopts="--ignore-glob=agents/*/test_client.py --suppress-no-test-exit-code" and a new dev dependency-group entry for pytest-custom-exit-code, with an inline comment confirming this repo has no pytest-based suite and the flag exists specifically to make a 0-test collection exit 0 instead of pytest's normal exit code 5. Read python/agents/howto-guide-agent/test_client.py (62 lines) and python/agents/text-insights-agent/test_client.py (62 lines) in full: neither defines any pytest-discoverable `def test_*` function (only main()/helper coroutines under `if __name__ == '__main__'`), both hard-code AGENT_URL to a localhost port and require the target agent process plus LLM credentials to be running, and both are the only place asserting the status/step-count/error-branch behavior added in agent.py and __main__.py for these two new agents.
